# No CI job builds dist/highlight, so code-fenced guides never render

## Context

Two hosted `workflow_dispatch` runs at `dev@f8425236af` (2026-09-14), each measuring an arm excluded from the e2e tier as "observed, cause not established":

- [34880690522](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/34880690522) — `portal/LearnLinkRoutingNL` ×3: the in-content-link arm `:77` fails **3/3**, the article still showing the source guide; the three sibling arms pass 3/3.
- [34880701320](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/34880701320) — `rendering/LivePreviewMultiWindow` ×2: the three Dev arms that visit `FormsEngine` fail; the Home-route arm passes 2/2.

Both pass locally. The operator confirmed the engine now imports highlight.js into the App Worker, with the main-thread `HighlightJS` addon effectively legacy.

## The Problem

A guide renders only if every code fence that survives extraction can be highlighted, and on a CI runner none can.

- `src/util/HighlightJs.mjs#load()` imports `Neo.config.basePath + 'dist/highlight/highlight.custom(.min).js'` into the App Worker and caches only a success.
- `src/component/Markdown.mjs#render()` extracts `mermaid`, `live-preview` and `json neo-component` fences, then highlights **every other fence** (`regexCodeBlock` does not check for `readonly`) and awaits `Promise.all` **before** `set({html})`. The plaintext `.catch` retry calls `load()` again, so a failed import rejects `render()`: the article keeps its previous HTML, or stays empty on a first load. The error stays in the App Worker, and the import is worker-initiated, so a page network log shows nothing.
- `dist/highlight` is gitignored (`/dist`) and is not an npm dependency. Only `build-highlightjs` produces it (a GitHub clone, `npm install`, build) and `build-all` runs that. `bundle-browser-deps` — parse5, marked, mermaid — does not, and it is what `test.yml`, `test-e2e.yml`, `consumer-runtime-build.yml` and `check-package-contents.yml` run. A fresh checkout lacks the file; a checkout that once ran `build-all` keeps it, which is why the arms pass locally.

Surviving fences separate every hosted observation:

| page | surviving fences | hosted |
|---|---|---|
| `DockLayouts` (direct load) | 0 | renders |
| `UsingTheseTopics` (sidebar) | 0 | renders |
| `DockLayoutsAdoption` (in-content link) | 14 | keeps the source guide |
| `FormsEngine` (direct load) | 4 | empty article |
| `DockLayoutsFirstLayout` (`LearnMermaidRender`'s editor route) | 2 | no editor |

Two aggravations:

- **`buildScripts/build/highlightJs.mjs` exits 0 when it fails.** Its `catch` logs and returns; `mermaid.mjs` and `parse5.mjs` call `process.exit(1)`. The clone has failed transiently before (a `bootstrapWorktree` `build-all` run, 2026-05-30), so wiring it into CI as-is could reproduce this defect behind a green step.
- **The package cannot ship it.** `.npmignore` re-includes only parse5, marked and mermaid, and `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` in `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents.mjs` omits it — although its `dist/mermaid.mjs` rationale describes an importer building the same `Neo.config.basePath + 'dist/…'` URL. Consumer runtime impact is not verified.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/util/HighlightJs.mjs` — worker singleton, lazy `import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ path)`.
- `src/component/Markdown.mjs` — `render()` pass order; `processReadonlyCodeBlocks()`; `regexCodeBlock`.
- `package.json` — `bundle-browser-deps`, `build-highlightjs`.
- `buildScripts/build/highlightJs.mjs` — skip-if-exists, clone, install, build, swallowed failure.
- `.github/workflows/classify-test-scope.yml` — `e2eScriptKeys` pins the bundle scripts whose change triggers e2e.
- `buildScripts/util/check-package-contents.mjs` + `.npmignore` — the shipped `dist/` set.
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` — the three exclusions this explains.

## The Fix

1. `bundle-browser-deps` also runs `build-highlightjs`, matching the browser artifacts `build-all` produces.
2. `highlightJs.mjs` exits non-zero on failure, as its sibling bundlers do.
3. `e2eScriptKeys` gains `build-highlightjs`.
4. Record the package decision: ship `dist/highlight/highlight.custom.min.js` (a `REQUIRED_ENTRIES` row with its `why`, plus the `.npmignore` re-include), or record why consumers do not need it.
5. Measure the build's added CI time; add a cache keyed on the build script if a cold build is slow or flaky.
6. `e2eCiSelection.mjs`: `LearnLinkRoutingNL` returns to `RUN_PATHS`; the `LivePreviewMultiWindow` entry records the Dev arms' cause (its Dist half is unchanged); the `LearnMermaidRender` entry records its precondition's cause and names #18675 as the remaining blocker, replacing a pointer to the closed #18568.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bundle-browser-deps` | `package.json` | also builds `dist/highlight` | skip-if-exists keeps warm runs cheap | `buildScripts/README.md` | hosted dispatch on the branch |
| `build-highlightjs` exit status | `buildScripts/build/highlightJs.mjs` | non-zero on any failure | none — a failure must be loud | script docblock | a failing run observed non-zero |
| `e2eScriptKeys` | `classify-test-scope.yml` | includes `build-highlightjs` | — | inline comment | `buildDependencyResolution.spec.mjs` |
| shipped `dist/` set | `REQUIRED_ENTRIES`, `.npmignore` | decision recorded with its reason | — | the entry's `why` | `check-package-contents` job |
| e2e selection | `e2eCiSelection.mjs` | three entries updated | — | entry `reason` text | selection floor + CI run |

## Decision Record impact

`none` — no decision record governs `dist/` bundles or package contents.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — red-first: a hosted dispatch of `LearnLinkRoutingNL` ×3 on a branch whose only change builds the bundle turns arm `:77` green 3/3 (baseline: run 34880690522, red 3/3).
- [ ] **AC-2** — the `LivePreviewMultiWindow` Dev arms that visit `FormsEngine` pass hosted, and the Home-route arm still passes.
- [ ] **AC-3** — `build-highlightjs` exits non-zero when clone, install or build fails.
- [ ] **AC-4** — a change to `build-highlightjs` classifies as e2e-relevant.
- [ ] **AC-5** — the package decision and its reason are recorded, and `check-package-contents` passes.
- [ ] **AC-6** — the added CI time is measured and stated; a cache is added if warranted.
- [ ] **AC-7** — the three `e2eCiSelection.mjs` entries are updated as above and the selection floor passes.

## Out of Scope

- Replacing the custom bundle with the `highlight.js` npm package — a dependency decision.
- The legacy main-thread `HighlightJS` addon.
- #18675, the DockLayouts guide rendering its body twice.
- The Dist arms' production build.
- A stale-response race in `Neo.app.content.Component#doFetchContent`, which assigns `value` without checking that the record is still current — captured as a defect-note.

## Avoided Traps

- **A longer assertion window.** Falsified 2026-09-07: widened to 30s, the arm still failed at 32.4s.
- **Building it only in `test-e2e.yml`.** The unit, consumer-runtime and package-contents runners, and every fresh checkout, keep the gap.
- **Reading a green `build-highlightjs` step as proof.** Today it exits 0 on failure.

Resolves the root cause behind #18422 and #18427. Related: #18554 (App Worker errors never reach a test), #18675, #7790 (created the bundle), #7823 (skip-if-exists), #17492 (the clone's argv).

- The comments that said the loader imports the minified file are corrected, and the debug doc tag states the declared value.

Addresses RA-1 of the R1 review by @neo-gpt-emmy."

#18702 inserts a restored code token verbatim, which removes the mechanism behind DockLayouts.md's four diagrams for two fences. This reverts eae903f898: the portal directory is one RUN_PATHS entry again and the exclusion is gone.

* fix(build): the package ships both highlight bundles the loader can request (#18704)

HighlightJs declares debug: true while its JSDoc said false, so load() requests dist/highlight/highlight.custom.js, and the package shipped only the minified file: an installed engine could not load its default. Hosted CI builds both files, which is why no render failed there.

- .npmignore re-includes both bundles and REQUIRED_ENTRIES requires both, so either debug value loads for a consumer; the default is unchanged.
- getBundlePath() owns the choice. unit/util/HighlightJs.spec.mjs packs package.json and .npmignore over a stand-in at every path it returns and runs the real load() against only the packed files: red on the previous rules, green here, and a rename inside getBundlePath() reds it.
- The comments that said the loader imports the minified file are corrected, and the debug doc tag states the declared value.

Addresses RA-1 of the R1 review by @neo-gpt-emmy."
